## [Price lower a few days later of what I paid](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a0b5b0a04da3e7c3a010ea6)
It’s frustrating that I purchased over $3,000 in 3 furniture items only to see the price drop by 30% a few days later and my item has not yet arrived. I attempted to reach them to ask them to adjust my order to reflect the new price and but there is No Phone number. One cannot reach anyone by phone. I sent an email to request this adjustment on price . Their website states if your order received free shipping or any other discount they will not give the lower price even though the customer paid price is still higher. It also states it is from the "order" date not the "received shipment" date. Your shipment is not likely to arrive within 7 days. Good news though! They reached out by email and gave me a store credit for the difference on my items despite their policy. Thus, they have a satisfied customer.

May 5, 2026

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 18, 2026

We understand how frustrating it can be to see pricing change shortly after placing an order, especially on a large purchase, and we apologize for the delay in communication.

Our policy allows price adjustments on full-priced items purchased within 7 days of a promotion, provided no previous offers or discounts were applied. Eligible adjustments are issued as store credit for the difference before taxes, and promotional offers cannot be combined.

A representative from our team will be following up shortly to further review and assist with your request. We truly appreciate your patience and the opportunity to assist you as a first-time customer.
